## Burning Springs: Head Hunts

Image Credit: Bethesda ***Subject to change pending porting to live servers*** How to start Head Hunts You need a Wanted Poster to start a Head Hunt. Posters can be obtained in two ways: either by buying one from The Ghoul or by earning one as a reward from Grunt Hunts. You start the Head Hunt itself by taking the poster to the Bounty Board and pinning it. ***Subject to change pending porting to live servers*** Grunt Hunt Rewards For every successful event, you will receive XP 1000 XP Legendary Modules You receive up to 3 Legendary Modules: 1 module – 100% 1 additional module – 60% chance 1 additional module – 40% chance Event Legendary (reward screen) You always receive 1 legendary item. ## Burning Springs: Grunt Hunt Guide

***Subject to change pending porting to live servers*** How to start Grunt Hunts There is no questline, cost, or requirements to start a Grunt Hunt. Simply fast travel to Highway Town > Bounty Board From the Bounty Board, turn left, and you will see The Last Resort. Enter the saloon and face north.
